rules.description: Verifies that all StatVars within each input split share the same latest observation date (MaxDate).

Verifies that every StatVar in each input split meets its expected latest observation date and institution-type qualification (2012 for 2010-2012 non-JJ StatVars, 2016 for the 2016 JJ/NotJJ split, and >= GREATEST(2024, YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 4) for 2018_onwards JJ/NotJJ StatVars).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate, CASE WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) <= 2012 AND StatVar NOT LIKE '%JuvenileJusticeFacility%' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) = 2012 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2016 AND StatVar LIKE '%JuvenileJusticeFacility%' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) = 2016 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) >= 2018 AND StatVar LIKE '%JuvenileJusticeFacility%' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= GREATEST(2024, YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 4) ELSE FALSE END AS is_fresh FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'EMPTY_STATS' AS StatVar, '' AS MinDate, '' AS MaxDate, FALSE AS is_fresh WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stats)
